connections.notes: Fresh feed: (1, 1, 1) mol/s at 300 K and P_r, liquid (derivation §4).
Adiabatic mixer outlet. The v0.0 closure is restricted to the subcooled-liquid domain; derivation §7 finding 5 shows no registered r-variant leaves it.
Heater outlet at the specified temperature. Two-phase in three of the five registered variants (derivation §7 finding 2), which is a supported result.
Vapor product. Exactly zero flow in the 310 K variant; ZERO_FLOW is a phase signature, not a failure (ADR 0001 D3.4).
Flash liquid at the flash temperature and pressure.

Liquid recycle. Its T and P are known from the flash specification, so the tear needs only its three component flows; T01 must rediscover that from the incidence graph rather than have it hard-coded (plan §3.2).
Purge. Together with S4 it carries the whole external product balance.

description: T04's continuation case HOM-03: the flash duty for 352 K from a 410 K guess. The contract cycles VAPOR → TWO_PHASE → LIQUID; recovery edge 3 stalls at λ = 23/256, the dew point on the vapour-branch path bracketed within 2^-9. Only the guess and Q_flash differ from SYN-001-A02-355-dew-guess.
